name: Sessionise Events
description: Groups each user's timestamped events into sessions by an inactivity gap, adding session IDs to events and producing a session summary with duration, landing and exit events.
introductoryText:
Turns a raw stream of timestamped events (web or app clicks, machine log lines, card transactions, door entries) into **sessions**, the way web analytics tools do: for each user or device, a new session starts when the gap since their previous event is longer than a timeout (30 minutes by default) or, optionally, when a session reaches a maximum length.

**Events output**: every input row with *Session ID*, *Session Number* (per user), *Event Number In Session*, *Seconds Since Previous Event* and *Is Session Start*.

**Sessions output**: one row per session with start, end, duration, number of events, first event (landing page) and last event (exit page), total value (such as order value) and a bounce flag (one-event sessions).

Events can arrive in any order; they are sorted by user and time. Rows without a user or a valid timestamp are kept in the events output without a session.

options.name: user_field
options.title: User or device field
options.description: Who the events belong to: visitor ID, device, card number, badge.

options.name: time_field
options.title: Timestamp field
options.description: Date and time of each event.

options.name: event_field
options.title: Event name field (optional)
options.description: Page, screen or event type; gives the first and last event of each session.

options.name: value_field
options.title: Value field (optional)
options.description: Summed per session, such as order value.

options.name: gap_minutes
options.title: Inactivity gap (minutes)
options.description: A gap longer than this starts a new session. 30 is the web analytics convention.

options.name: max_session_hours
options.title: Maximum session length (hours)
options.description: Optional: split sessions longer than this. 0 = no limit.

blockOutputs.label: Sessions
blockOutputs.tooltip: One row per session: user, start, end, duration, events, first and last event, total value, bounce.
